تداخلت (form VI)

# تَدَاخَلْتَ (tadāḵalta) /ta.daː.xal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
# تَدَاخَلْتِ (tadāḵalti) /ta.daː.xal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
# تَدَاخَلَتْ (tadāḵalat) /ta.daː.xa.lat/: third-person fem
